name: web_search
description: Search the public web (Serper-backed) when the user asks about something that the wiki probably doesn't contain — current events, library docs, third-party services, news. Returns up to 10 results: each is `{title, link, snippet, published_date?}`. Snippets are short — call `open_url(link)` on the most promising result(s) to read the full page. Prefer `search_wiki` first when the question could plausibly be answered by the user's own wiki content.

query.description: Search query in plain English. Be specific — e.g. "flask 3.0 streaming response keep-alive" beats "flask streaming".
